g1.flow: Al-Aḥzāb 33:45 alone opens with the call yā ayyuha n-nabiyyu and keeps describing him: 'one who invites to Allāh … an illuminating lamp'. Al-Fatḥ 48:8 has no call; it follows 'to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth' and turns to the people: 'that you may believe … and exalt Him morning and afternoon'. Hook: Al-Aḥzāb calls out and adds the lamp; Al-Fatḥ goes straight to believing.

cues.33:45: Opens yā ayyuha n-nabiyyu; after the greeting 'Peace'; next, inviter to Allāh, illuminating lamp.
cues.48:8: No 'O Prophet'; after the soldiers of the heavens and earth; next, 'that you may believe'.
